item.description:
CC Pilot 0.5.0: Kimi Code usage.
- **Kimi Code usage**: choose Kimi Code under "Add Profile…" and enter a name and an API key created in the Kimi Code console. The panel shows its 5-hour and weekly usage when you refresh. You can add several keys. Kimi Code is usage-only: there is no switching, and it isn't shown in the menu bar. - The API key is stored in your login keychain and sent only to Kimi when you refresh. You can copy it from the account's card: the copy stays on this Mac, is marked so that clipboard managers following the standard convention skip it, and is cleared after 1 minute. - Kimi's usage API is experimental and undocumented. If it changes, the app will tell you to update.
---
CC Pilot 0.5.0：显示 Kimi Code 额度。
- **Kimi Code 额度**：在"添加账号…"里选 Kimi Code，填一个名称和在 Kimi Code 控制台创建的 API key。点刷新后，面板会显示它的 5 小时和周额度。可以添加多个 key。Kimi Code 只显示额度，不能切换，也不显示在菜单栏里。 - API key 保存在你的登录钥匙串里，只在刷新时发给 Kimi。可以在账号卡片上复制它：复制的内容只留在本机、遵守约定的剪贴板管理工具不会记录，1 分钟后自动清空。 - Kimi 的额度接口是实验性的，没有官方文档。接口变了，App 会提示你更新。

CC Pilot 0.4.2
- The Claude Code icon in the menu bar is now shown in Claude's orange, matching the panel, so it stands out from ChatGPT at a glance.
---
CC Pilot 0.4.2
- 菜单栏里的 Claude Code 图标改用 Claude 的橙色，与面板里一致，和 ChatGPT 一眼就能分开。

CC Pilot 0.4.1
- When the menu bar shows only one tool, its icon now appears to the left of the two lines, so you can tell at a glance whether the plan and usage are for Claude Code or ChatGPT.
---
CC Pilot 0.4.1
- 菜单栏只显示一个工具时，两行文字左侧会显示这个工具的图标，一眼就能看出套餐和额度是 Claude Code 还是 ChatGPT 的。
